name: Fairmont Doha
positioning: Fairmont hotel in the Katara Towers in the Marina District of Lusail City, Doha
best_for: Travelers who want Arabian Gulf or Lusail City views
Guests who want a hotel-within-a-hotel Fairmont Gold stay
Families who want a Kids Club

facts.text: The hotel is in the Katara Towers in Doha.
The hotel's address is in the Marina District of Lusail City.
Rooms and suites have Arabian Gulf or Lusail City views.
Rooms have marble bathrooms with gold-tiled walk-in showers.
Rooms have a maxi bar with Qatari specialities.
The Two-Bedroom Shanghai Theme Suite pays homage to the imperial legacy of the Orient.
The Presidential Suite spans two floors and has a show kitchen, cinema, private gym and plunge pool.
Fairmont Gold is a hotel-within-a-hotel with a private pool and an exclusive lounge.
Dining menus include Asian, Mediterranean and South American dishes, and afternoon tea.
The spa offers a Hammam ritual combined with a meditation session.

considerations.text: Hamad International Airport is about 27 km from the hotel, a 35-minute ride.
The hotel does not accommodate pets.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is outside the central Doha business district.
